I can't mark it complete. I can only report and recommend, and I have no way to change a document's status. Even with sign-off, recording it as complete would be false: nobody has signed it yet.

**Where the Stark NDA stands** (Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement — Stark County Powder Coating Inc, ID `9a8497db-ce2d-453b-bfbb-dee842c343ca`):
- **Status:** sent, 15.8 days ago.
- **Still waiting on both signers:**
  - Lisa Morrow (lisa.morrow@starkpowdercoat.com)
  - Curtis Nagy (curtis.nagy@keystoneprecision.com)
- **Recommendation: reissue.** Every signing link has expired, so a plain reminder would send them to a dead link.

**Fastest way to get it signed today:**
1. Someone with permission sends it again with new links. The executor can do this once a person allows it.
2. Curtis Nagy is on your side (keystoneprecision.com), so he can probably sign as soon as the new link arrives.
3. Lisa Morrow at Stark has to sign too. A direct call or email to her once the new link is out is your best bet. I have no information on why she hasn't signed yet.

The "Powder Coating Services Renewal FY27" for the same company is stuck in the same way: same two signers, expired links. It may be worth sending both again together.
